gameDescriptionHtml:
Set sail for a world built for curiosity in Gecko Gods; a serene puzzle-adventure platformer where you explore a forgotten archipelago through the eyes of a tiny gecko.

Climb across sunlit ruins, weave through lush caves, and uncover the remnants of an ancient civilization, all at your own pace. Each path holds something new to discover as you glide between islands on your small wooden boat, every stop offering new puzzles to solve, insects to snack on and secrets to uncover.

With its relaxing atmosphere and intuitive blend of open-ended exploration and fluid platforming, Gecko Gods invites you to experience the world through entirely new eyes, encouraging curiosity and transforming even the smallest details of its environment into moments of discovery and wonder.

Game Features

  • Serene Exploration – Experience a world designed for curiosity and gentle adventure, where movement itself is part of the joy.
  • Sail Between Islands – Drift across tranquil seas to discover unique landscapes, each with its own atmosphere and hidden life.
  • Explore Freely – Scale walls, ceilings and cliffs with the gecko’s effortless agility.
  • Solve Ancient Puzzles – Delve into ruins and temples filled with intuitive, environmental challenges.
